tool_input.description: Run test suite before the fixes

tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/src"; echo hi > "$t/src/a.txt"
for s in 20260101-120000 20260102-120000 20260103-120000 20260104-120000; do BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash rotate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo "$t/src" >/dev/null; done
R=$PWD
echo "--- dry-run keep 2:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest="$t/dest" --name=demo --keep=2 -n
echo "--- keep 0 (expect usage die rc1):"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 0 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- keep abc (expect die rc1):"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep abc 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- unknown option (expect rc1):"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate --help first line:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --help | head -n 1; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify --name filter:"; bash "$R/verify.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo
echo "--- verify missing dest (expect rc2):"; bash "$R/verify.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/nope" 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify --help first line:"; bash "$R/verify.sh" --help | head -n 1
echo "--- positional arg rejected (expect rc1):"; bash "$R/verify.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" extra 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Sanity-check all flags of rotate.sh and verify.sh after refactor
Remove sanity script and show changed files

result:
Changed: `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` (bugs fixed, shared parser/`resolve_dir` replaced by a source line), new `lib/common.sh`, and `tests/run_tests.sh` (new rotate `--keep` group and spaced-name verify test) — all 10 tests pass; `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.

Notes: the rotate fix keeps the newest N by taking `head -n (total − keep)` from the oldest-first list (the old `tail -n +keep` deleted from the newest end) and exits early when `total == keep` to avoid a BSD `head -n 0` stderr complaint; verify now takes the archive name from the sidecar's own basename (minus `.sha256`) so spaces survive, and quotes the digest comparison. I also left a harmless scratch file at `/tmp/flag_sanity.sh` (manual flag sweep; deleting it needed a permission I skipped).
